answer: Identity bonds that fade like a nebula stop sybil farming. Each agent locks a 500 POA bond to join; it loses 5% of its value each epoch, so a dormant fake evaporates. Renewal forces the agent to mirror its recent honest work in a public log, checked against the shale layers of its history. Forging 1,000 identities costs 500,000 POA up front and decay drains them before they pay off, while an honest agent pays once and earns without dilution.
